notes.title: Cole Hunter: Payback now playable during Debut Festival
notes.notes:
[h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702099/558d5be207a6cabd41111fd94aaa45ed2950a905.png"][/img][/h1][h1]Cole Hunter: Payback is now playable during Steam [b]Debut Festival 2025[/b].[/h1][h2]
From [b]Thursday Aug 7 at 11 am PDT to Monday Aug 11 at 11 am PDT[/b] our playtest will be [b]OPEN ACCESS[/b] - no wait, no key, just click and play.[/h2][p][b]
What’s in the build[/b][/p][list][*][p]1 planet, 2 variants, one full boss and a horde of enemies[/p][/*][*][p]First ship with 5 implicit abilities (weapons)[/p][/*][*][p]No NDA, stream, record, and share your runs
[/p][/*][/list][p](If you are already on the waiting list - you’re in. Access will be granted automatically when the festival begins.)[/p][p][b]
We need your feedback![/b][/p][p]Share your comments on our [url="https://forms.gle/fHNV1gWZf4abvmoJ9" style="button"]Survey[/url] or jump into our [url="https://discord.com/invite/fSBXcMdUTq" style="button"]Discord[/url] to tell us what you think, report bugs, or show off your craziest builds.[/p][p]
Enjoy the festival, and don’t forget to [b]add the game to your wishlist[/b] so you’ll be first in line when the campaign launches.
[/p][p]Captain Hunter wishes you a fun time! [/p]
